name: zrndr_rasterize_poly
description: zRndr_RasterizePoly reduces duplicate polygon vertices, builds fixed-point scan-convert edge tables, and dispatches selected span operations for covered framebuffer rows.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 byte target covers 0x4936d0 but remains below tier S: verify vc5 0x4936d0 reports 1750 unmasked function-byte mismatches after 48 relocation-masked bytes and 4 trimmed VC NOP bytes, BN size 1822 bytes and VC5 symbol size 752 bytes.
Source owner/data are accepted through the zRndr_Draw.cpp scan-conversion owner pass; remaining tier S debt is coherent scan-conversion helper inlining/codegen shape.
Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited by x87 status-word comparisons and fixed-point conversion artifacts, but the assembly was inspected for the source contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4936d0 validates consecutive and closing duplicate vertex reduction, top/bottom vertex selection, gRndr_ScanConvertMode-controlled edge-table side assignment, fixed-point x step/current x tables, scanline start/end rounding, gRndr_CurrentSpanBaseAddr updates, and gRndr_pfnSelectedSpanOp(spanOpContext, pixelCount) dispatch.

The native zRndr smoke verifies duplicate vertex reduction for a rectangle with repeated and closing vertices, both scan-convert mode side assignments, selected span context propagation, expected per-row pixel counts, and framebuffer row destinations.
VC5 data-symbol target zrndr_rasterize_poly_data passes for g_frameBuffer, g_pitchBytes, g_bytesPerPixel, g_scanConvertMode, g_pfnSelectedSpanOp, and g_spanCurrentSpanBaseAddr.
